prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent player avatar in the established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY human identity, face, expression, hairstyle, beard, pose and clothing reference, Dima Zalizniak. Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved warm gouache/colored-pencil medium, proper feline anatomy, contained bust framing and finish. Do not copy image 2's face, dark straight hair, black beard, serious frontal gaze or dark collared shirt. This is a different person.
Primary request: reimagine the man in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve his gently elongated oval face, high broad forehead with slightly receding temples, fine softly arched light-brown eyebrows, original eye shape and spacing with happy cheek creases, broad open friendly smile showing upper teeth, and narrower rounded chin. Preserve the short full GINGER/AUBURN beard and connected light reddish-brown moustache, with its neat close trimmed outline along the jaw and chin, as darker reddish feline fur around the short muzzle and lower face. Keep natural young-adult proportions and the cheerful warm expression rather than a broad serious older face. Real short natural feline muzzle, small elegant cat nose and fine whiskers; muted warm sandy/taupe fur, light cream cheek and muzzle highlights, reddish beard distinct from lighter face fur.
Hair: short natural light/medium brown hair with warm chestnut highlights, very close sides and a short softly WAVY textured top, matching the photograph. No tall quiff, long fringe, black buzz cut or overly curly long hair.
Anatomy: EXACTLY TWO pointed CAT ears TOTAL on TOP of the head, both fully contained with generous clear margin. Eye-level sides of head are uninterrupted short fur/hair: NO human ears, side ears, lower ears, fleshy lobes or extra ears.
Clothing: fully clothed warm burnt-orange/rust long-sleeved button-down shirt with pointed collar fastened at the collar tips by small white buttons, central row of small white buttons and a single chest patch pocket, as in the source. Preserve cotton texture and relaxed shoulders. No logos or lettering. Omit crossed hands, forearms, watch and bracelets for consistent clean upper-bust framing.
Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur, wavy cropped hair, reddish beard and cotton, warm brown outlines and ivory highlights, matching existing character portraits.
Composition: square canvas, one centered head-and-upper-torso bust, slight three-quarter head turn and eyes looking a little toward the viewer's RIGHT as in image 1, naturally smiling face, rounded lower shoulder silhouette, whole head, hair and both ears fully inside frame with generous transparent margins. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove the blurred greenery, trees and all scenery. No other people, props, background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
